name: Lulu
source:
A mysterious, peculiar girl who for some reason has taken up residence in the town's meeting hall.

Her actions and words are naturally naive, and her personality is elusive. While not outright mean-spirited, she often makes suggestive remarks that seem to imply something, and engages in enigmatic behavior.

She regularly gathers the town's girls for suspicious gatherings, but what is her true nature...?

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827979&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
